author: Bobby Grayson
description: Reuse these instead of re-proving: SysStep.mem_subs_cases is the induction workhorse (every subscription in a reachable system is an old one or a subscribe effect of the popped message); broadcast_stateOf/broadcast_mcount are the frame facts (a broadcast changes no state and only adds mailbox copies). Sys.Grows and Sys.Frame were deliberately NOT extended: an unsubscribe shrinks subs, so subs monotonicity is stated separately under Effect.keepsSubs / no-unsubscribe hypotheses.
title: GENERIC LEMMAS announced for sibling builders (all in the shared files, none example-specific).
